items.title: Description of the strata of the quiver variety for a generic stability parameter in the parabolic Levi example
items.author: Hiraku Nakajima
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 5 (2009) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2009.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's description of the strata of the quiver variety in the parabolic Levi-factor example (author Proposition at source lines 1656-1672, label prop:Levi): every stratum is the product of a regular part of a smaller quiver variety with a stratum of the W = 0 moduli space for the subgraph I^0, and the non-vanishing of that regular part forces the inequalities h_i . (w - v^0) >= 0 for i in I^0. The proof (source lines 1680-1708) has to pass from a closed point of the moduli space to a representative polystable module, use the constraint zeta^bullet . v' = 0 to locate the support of its W = 0 component, and then write down the explicit two-step complex built from the maps alpha_i and beta_i to extract the positivity statement of part (2) (proof lines 1702-1708). Part (2) is not proved from scratch but made apparent through that complex, which the author attributes to formula (4.2) of the earlier paper; the complex itself is displayed verbatim in the counted proof. H2.
